title: Armand Van Helden Set for Sydney’s THE WORKS Warehouse Series
summary: The Grammy-nominated house pioneer joins Overmono, Jayda G and KI/KI on the 2026/27 lineup for the Carriageworks event series.
contentText:
Finely Tuned’s multi-day warehouse event series The Works will return to Sydney’s Carriageworks, with Armand Van Helden , Overmono, KI/KI, Jayda G, Ewan McVicar, salute, Sam Alfred, Job Jobse and more joining the 2026-27 program.

The Australian promoter announced the latest edition on Tuesday (Sept. 8), confirming a run of events across December and January at the inner-Sydney arts venue. The series will begin with an already announced, sold-out Pegassi all-night-long set on Dec. 5, before continuing across New Year’s Eve and four January dates.

The New Year’s Eve bill is led by Armand Van Helden, whose Billboard history includes “You Don’t Know Me,” which reached No. 2 on the Hot Dance/Electronic Songs chart, and Duck Sauce’s “Barbra Streisand,” which hit No. 1 on Dance Club Songs and No. 89 on the Hot 100.

Canadian DJ and producer Jayda G adds further pedigree: her 2020 track “Both of Us” earned a Grammy nomination for best dance recording, part of a career that’s also included a Peabody-nominated science documentary and a Mixmag Album of the Year win for 2019’s Significant Changes .

Welsh electronic duo Overmono, made up of brothers Tom and Ed Russell, headline Jan. 8. The pair appeared among Billboard’s Charts First-Timers in 2023 following the release of their debut album, Good Lies .

The season will close Jan. 9 with Amsterdam producer and DJ KI/KI, whose high-speed sets draw from acid, techno, trance and rave sounds. Her tracks include “5 Mins of Acid,” “Leave It to the Vibe” and the Armin van Buuren collaboration “Put Your Bassline.”

The Works launched in 2025 as part of Finely Tuned’s Sydney events calendar, presenting large-scale electronic music shows at Carriageworks. Its first edition featured artists including Underworld, Ben Böhmer, Chris Stussy, CamelPhat, I Hate Models, Michael Bibi and Pretty Girl.

Founded in 2006, Finely Tuned has built a portfolio across Australian festivals, club events, tours and brand activations, including Lost Paradise, Lost Sundays, Above and Paradise Club.

Presale for The Works begins Sept. 15 at 10 a.m. AEST, with general onsale following Sept. 16 at 10 a.m. AEST.

The Works 2026-27 dates are below.

Dec. 5 — Pegassi (all night long) — sold out

Dec. 31 — Armand Van Helden; Ewan McVicar b2b salute; Jayda G

Jan. 6 — Rossi.; Dean Turley b2b Jamback; Stacie Fields

Jan. 7 — Sam Alfred b2b Job Jobse (open to close)

Jan. 8 — Overmono

Jan. 9 — KI/KI
